rows.name: kind?
rows.notes: "label" is a text tag, "count" the pill, "dot" the mute point.

rows.name: tone?
rows.notes: Defaults to "danger" for count/dot (red) and "neutral" for label.

rows.name: variant?
rows.notes: Defaults to "solid" for count/dot (the pill recipe) and "tint" for label.

rows.name: count?
rows.notes: kind="count" only. Truncated to an integer, floored at 0.

rows.name: max?
rows.notes: Display ceiling: count > max renders "{max}+". No ceiling by default.

rows.name: showZero?
rows.notes: count === 0 renders "0" instead of hiding. Default false.

rows.name: label?
rows.notes: The accessible replacement for a visible value that lies ("99+"): sets role="img" + aria-label, so what a screen reader gets is the truth.

rows.name: overlap?
rows.notes: Pinned on the top-trailing corner of a positioned host (CSS recipe).

rows.name: children?
rows.notes: The badge's content, re-declared rather than inherited so the one surprise in the part is written down: explicit children **win** over the value the derivation computes. `kind="count"` fills in the truncated digits on its own, and passing children replaces them — localised numerals, a glyph beside a label. Left out, `label` and `dot` render nothing at all rather than an empty text node (`badge.tsx:43`), which is what keeps the dot exactly `--sui-badge-dot-size` across instead of one text node wider.
